description: This PHP source file provides helper functions for rendering and processing custom 'radio head' fields within the TestLink open-source test management project. It defines functions to generate HTML radio input elements for custom fields and to prepare those values for database storage.

methods.name: string_input_radio_head
methods.description: Generates HTML string with radio button inputs for a custom 'radio head' field based on its definition and current value.

methods.name: build_cfield_radio_head
methods.description: Prepares and serializes the custom field value for database storage, handling multiple selections if present.
